info.title: AbpGuard API
info.description: AbpGuard.HttpApi's actions under api/guard (the token endpoint, OpenIddict's, isn't here). Errors are ABP's: { "error": { "code", "message", "details", "data", "validationErrors" } }; a step-up asked is 403 step_up_required with data { level, category, methods, appCodeAlone, maxAgeSeconds }.
